description: This Java source file defines the ModelTree class and its nested classes, modeling a read-only, immutable representation of a tree structure based on XML configuration, used for rendering hierarchical widget components in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ModelTree
classes.description: Represents a hierarchical tree structure configured via XML, used for rendering widget trees in OFBiz.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode
classes.description: Models a node within the tree, including its actions, conditions, labels, links, and sub-nodes.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode.Image
classes.description: Models an image element within a node, including its attributes like src, height, width, etc.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode.Label
classes.description: Models a label element within a node, including text, id, and style.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode.Link
classes.description: Models a hyperlink element within a node, including parameters, target, style, and associated image.

classes.name: ModelTree.ModelNode.ModelSubNode
classes.description: Models a sub-node element, including its actions, node name, and iterator management.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor for traversing or processing the ModelTree.

methods.name: getBoundaryCommentName
methods.description: Returns a boundary comment name for the tree, used in rendering.

methods.name: getDefaultEntityName
methods.description: Returns the default entity name associated with the tree.

methods.name: getDefaultPkName
methods.description: Returns the primary key name for the default entity, based on the context.

methods.name: getExpandCollapseRequest
methods.description: Constructs and returns the expand/collapse request URL based on context.

methods.name: getOpenDepth
methods.description: Returns the open depth for the tree nodes.

methods.name: getPostTrailOpenDepth
methods.description: Returns the post-trail open depth setting.

methods.name: getRenderStyle
methods.description: Returns the default render style for the tree.

methods.name: getRootNodeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the root node.

methods.name: getTrailName
methods.description: Returns the trail name expanded from the context.

methods.name: getWrapStyle
methods.description: Returns the wrap style based on context.

methods.name: renderTreeString
methods.description: Renders the entire tree structure as a string using the provided renderer.
